children: valued at up to $92.2M over the next three years to support the Department of War Test Resource Management Center SkyRange program.

SkyRange is the DoW’s flagship initiative to modernize hypersonic flight test infrastructure. The program replaces fixed and ship-based range assets with high-altitude airborne platforms capable of collecting, relaying, and distributing real-time telemetry data.

Under the contract, AEVEX will provide airborne range integration and engineering services, flight operations support across Western U.S. and Pacific test corridors, airborne telemetry relay and resilient communications architecture support, payload and mission systems integration, and distributed range networking, instrumentation, and mission data support.
